Name: SESSION_RANDOM_ASSET_TEX_REPLACE_PARAM_ST
Description: Random asset texture swaps per session: for the session's key, one group of rows is drawn and each row's texture pairs are applied.

Fields.Name: Session Key
Fields.Description: The row is a candidate only when this equals the session's texture key (998 in one special session type). Retail: 10-190, 998, 999.

Fields.Name: Group
Fields.Description: Candidate rows with the same value form a group; one group is drawn at random per session and all its rows apply. Retail: one group per key (0, or the key itself for keys 140 and 160-190), so retail never draws between groups.

Fields.Name: Texture Pair 1 - Name A
Fields.Description: First texture of the swap, e.g. AET801_250. Must be exactly 10 characters and an existing texture, or the pair is skipped. Which side is replaced by the other is not established.

Fields.Name: Texture Pair 1 - Name B
Fields.Description: Second texture of the swap, same rules as Name A. Retail: always an AET550 texture.

Fields.Name: Texture Pair 2 - Name A
Fields.Description: A second swap applied by the same row, same rules as pair 1. Retail: empty on every row.

Fields.Name: Texture Pair 2 - Name B
Fields.Description: Second texture of the second swap. Retail: empty on every row.
